mainEntity.name: What is the best web hosting service?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your site. Hostinger is the best low-price start, Cloudways is the best managed cloud, and Kinsta is the best premium managed WordPress host. Our picks above say who each one suits.

mainEntity.name: What is the cheapest web hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: hosting.com Starter is $1.49 a month on a 12-month plan and Spaceship Essential is $1.66 a month. Hostinger Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term. All three renew at higher prices, so compare the renewal column.

mainEntity.name: Which web host has the best uptime?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several hosts recorded 100% uptime in independent tests, including Hostinger, ScalaHosting, Kinsta and Liquid Web. Test windows are short, so treat uptime as a snapshot.

mainEntity.name: Which web host has the longest money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: InMotion lists 90 days on shared plans. BigScoots lists 45 days. Most others list 30.

mainEntity.name: Which web hosts have phone support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Network Solutions lists 24/7 phone and chat. InMotion adds phone support on Power and Pro. Hostinger and Kinsta have no phone line.

mainEntity.name: Is shared, VPS or dedicated hosting best for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finding the Universe suggests shared hosting for sites under about 10,000 visitors a month and a VPS from there. Dedicated servers suit very large sites.

mainEntity.name: What is the best web hosting for WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kinsta, Cloudways, Liquid Web and BigScoots are the managed WordPress options we checked. Hostinger and InMotion are lower-cost starts.

mainEntity.name: What is the best web hosting for an online store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Liquid Web handled 1,000 concurrent users with 0% errors in two tests, but one test saw a slow checkout. Cloudways and Kinsta are alternatives. Check how your payment provider handles PCI.

mainEntity.name: Which web hosts have AI tools?
